meta.name: devops-router
meta.description: Use for broad DevOps, infrastructure, deployment, automation, operations, security, incident, cloud, Kubernetes, CI/CD, container, IaC, scripting, observability, or network/VPN requests that need safe routing before implementation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 帮你自动分流各类运维请求到正确的处理工具
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常接到各种运维请求,想先自动分流到正确的处理工具
copy.tagline_en: Auto-route messy DevOps requests to the correct tool
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often deal with diverse DevOps requests and want them auto-routed to the right tool

howto.what: Claude 会先当 DevOps 请求的路由入口:读取路由规则,把请求归类(构建、变更、迁移、加固、事故、排障、评审等),再选出最窄的技能链,并在实施前告诉你选了哪条链。
howto.when: 当请求涉及 DevOps、基础设施、部署、自动化、运维、安全、事故、云、Kubernetes、CI/CD、容器、IaC、脚本、可观测性或网络/VPN 时触发;宽泛、混合或含混的请求也会进入路由。

say.text: 帮我排查一下这个 Kubernetes 集群最近的高负载,先只读。
say.note: 走只读路由,不触发变更。

say.text: 先别改任何配置,把这份 CI/CD 流水线的风险列出来。
say.note: 按分析模式评估,不做写入。

say.text: 给我一份生产环境回滚方案,先不要执行。
say.note: 产出方案并提示风险和回滚。

howto.what_en: Claude is a DevOps intake/router: it reads routing rules, classifies requests (build, change, migration, hardening, incident, debugging, review, etc.), routes to the narrowest skill, and states the chosen chain before implementation.
howto.when_en: Triggered by DevOps, Kubernetes, cloud, CI/CD, IaC, security, incident, network/VPN, or similar ops/infra requests; also for broad, mixed, or ambiguous requests that need routing.

say_en.text: Investigate the high load on this Kubernetes cluster; read-only first.
Don't change any config; list the risks in this CI/CD pipeline first.
say_en.note: Runs in analysis mode; no writes.

say_en.text: Give me a production rollback plan; don't execute anything yet.
say_en.note: Produces a plan with risks and rollback.
